title: AliExpress Search Scraper
description: Scrape AliExpress search and category results with prices, sales, ratings and delivery.

searchQueries.title: Search keywords
searchQueries.description: Words to search on AliExpress, one search per line, as in the search box.

startUrls.title: Search or category links
startUrls.description: Links copied from AliExpress: a search such as https://www.aliexpress.com/w/wholesale-yoga-mat.html or a category such as https://www.aliexpress.com/category/100003109/women-clothing.html. Filters in the link (category, price, ship-from, free shipping) are kept.

sort.title: Sort by
sort.description: The order of the results, as on AliExpress. "Orders" puts the best sellers first.

maxItemsPerSearch.title: Products per search
maxItemsPerSearch.description: How many products to save for each keyword or link. AliExpress shows 60 products per page and at most 60 pages (3,600 products).

shipTo.title: Ship to
shipTo.description: The delivery country. AliExpress shows prices, delivery times and some products for this country. Keyword searches work for every country; category pages are empty when shipping to France or Spain.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The currency of the prices. Leave empty for the currency of the ship-to country.

minPrice.title: Minimum price
minPrice.description: Only products from this price, in the currency above.

maxPrice.title: Maximum price
maxPrice.description: Only products up to this price, in the currency above.

shipFrom.title: Ships from
shipFrom.description: Only products shipped from this country, such as the local warehouses in the United States or Spain.

minRating.title: Minimum rating
minRating.description: Only products rated this or higher, from 0 to 5. Products without a rating yet are skipped when this is set.

minSold.title: Minimum sold
minSold.description: Only products sold at least this many times. Products without sales are skipped when this is set. With "Orders" sorting, a search stops at the first page where every product is below this number.

skipSponsored.title: Skip ads
skipSponsored.description: Leave out sponsored products (marked "Ad" on AliExpress). They are kept by default and marked in the isSponsored field.

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many products in total. Leave empty or 0 for no limit.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: AliExpress shows a check page after a few pages from one address; the Actor then continues from a new address. Residential addresses in the United Kingdom work best (addresses in the United States are sent to aliexpress.us).
